blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) flagship project, DENR Express: Permitting on Wheels, served more than 10,000 clients and issued thousands of permits nationwide in its first five months since implementation in April 2026. According to a DENR statement on Wednesday, Environment Secretary Juan Miguel “Mitch” Cuna said the project was established to bring environmental permitting, technical assistance, and compliance guidance closer to communities, as well as micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) and project proponents.
